scope: The five retained planning records and the deterministic validation/tool summaries only.

findings.observation: The outline declares target_words 6000, while its six section word_target values sum to 5600. The action contract requires mutually consistent records, so the first transition does not complete the lifecycle baseline.

The campaign stopped before map-project, create-outline, plan-section, write-section, review-section, pause-writing, the fresh process boundary, resume-writing, and progress. No claim-plan traceability, evidence-dependency, verifier, or resumption result can be awarded.

The retained records preserve the synthetic scope, keep external literature deferred, avoid fabricated citations, and retain the three author decisions with author authority and their locked, deferred, and discretion dispositions.

quality_claim_limitation: This review assesses process and record invariants. The suite has no no-WTF-P control arm and cannot establish that WTF-P improves prose quality.
